episode_title: 203. Does 'Only Drinking on Special Occasions' Work at Christmas?

real_qa.q: What is occasioning as an alcohol moderation technique and how does it work during Christmas?
real_qa.r: Occasioning is a moderation technique in which you only drink on special occasions. It is a valid and well-practised moderation technique that works really well for some people, but like all moderation techniques, it can have its drawbacks if you don't practice it with intention. During Christmas, the challenge is that every moment can begin to feel like one long special occasion when in reality special occasions should not happen every day.

real_qa.q: How often should special occasions happen to qualify as occasions worthy of drinking?
real_qa.r: Special occasions don't tend to come around too often. Generally these events are few and far between. If the special occasion that you are considering is happening again and again and again during Christmas, then maybe you need to relegate it from a special occasion to just an occasion. real_qa.q: How should you prioritize your drinking energy across multiple December events and special occasions?
real_qa.r: Your diary is likely already starting to fill up with get-togethers, catch-ups, work dues, and Christmas lunches and family gatherings. The truth is that they can't all be special.
